title: Cognition Launches Dreaming Memory and Open Standard for Devin
summary:
The AI agent Devin now creates a persistent memory graph of user preferences across sessions to improve long term collaboration. This functionality, known as Dreaming, allows the agent to refine its internal data overnight by deleting obsolete records and identifying latent patterns. In tandem with the update, Cognition is introducing an open source software standard called Agent Memory Repo to facilitate how AI tools manage and share memory.

The company intends for Devin to function as a teammate with a brain that evolves over time rather than as a specialized coding tool or IDE. This approach is designed to prevent skill slop by automating the creation of skill files, removing the requirement for humans to manually manage those configuration files within a software repository.

I've been using this internally for a bit & so excited to now be able to talk about it

We are not building a one-off coding tool or an IDE. Our mission is to build a real teammate. This means Devin needs a "brain" that will learn how work and get more powerful over time

Plus it fixes one of the biggest agent mistakes people make - cluttering their repo with skill slop. Bad skills will make your harness a lot worse. 

Humans shouldn't write skill files, so let Devin handle it.
